_comment: Mega Chippy, Acomb (York) — LumiWEB customer, LIVE. Branding modelled on the reference site (Poppies Fish & Chips): indigo + teal on a clean light palette, heavy display type over Montserrat body. Legal entity: AYAZ LARA LTD (14372361). Live at megachippy.co.uk; Stripe Connect acct set; card + cash (collection & delivery) enabled. Reminder for future deploys: use Cloudflare 'Create deployment' (builds latest main) — a 'Retry' rebuilds an OLD commit and can ship stale config (e.g. cash flags).

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name.
business._comment_todo: Domain registered: megachippy.co.uk (GoDaddy registration, Cloudflare DNS). For receipt emails to actually SEND from orders@megachippy.co.uk, verify the domain in Resend (SPF/DKIM) and set RESEND_FROM_EMAIL=orders@megachippy.co.uk in Cloudflare; recommend Cloudflare Email Routing to forward orders@ to the shop's inbox so replies are received.

_comment_seo: Search-engine extras used to build the landing page's JSON-LD Restaurant schema + social meta. Purely for search engines — doesn't change the page visually.

seo.description: Mega Chippy — proper fish and chips in Acomb, York. Freshly fried cod & haddock, chunky chips, chippy classics and kids' boxes. Order online for collection.

_comment_theme: Palette + type taken from the customer's reference brand (Poppies Fish & Chips): CREAM background #FFF7E8 (never a cold white), indigo #3E46BA = primary (the pill buttons, headings, links), teal #54C2CC = secondary accent, and a warm heritage red #E23A2E for highlights (script wordmark / stars, echoing Poppies' red script logo). Type per the reference: headings = Rockwell Bold ('RockwellStdBold') → Rokkitt, its closest Google Fonts clone; UI caps (nav/buttons) = Heavitas → Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase; body = Montserrat; script accents = Pacifico (stand-in for the red brush-script logo). The shared order template puts light text on the primary colour, so primary stays dark enough for white text.

delivery._comment: POSTCODE (outcode) pricing + a hard 4-mile ROAD cap. Fee is set per outcode in feeByOutcode (pence). On top of that, maxMiles 4 with roadFactor 1.3 geocodes the postcode (postcodes.io, free) and refuses delivery beyond 4 road miles even for a priced outcode — so the sprawly bits of an outcode (e.g. YO26 reaching 6–7 miles) become collection-only. allowedOutcodes is the deliverable list; feePence is a safe fallback if an allowed outcode is ever left unpriced. Owner-agreed prices: YO24 £2, YO26 £2.50, YO23 £2.50, YO30 £3.50, YO1 £3.50, YO10 £6, YO31 £6.
delivery.areaDescription: in the York area (within 4 miles of us)

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order service charge in pence (shown at checkout). serviceFeePlatformPence is the platform's (Lumin Labs') cut taken as the Stripe application_fee; the rest stays with the shop. £1.00 charge = 50p platform + 50p shop.
_comment_stripe: Live Stripe Connect account for Mega Chippy (AYAZ LARA LTD). Platform Stripe secrets + this shop's Connect webhook (whsec) are set in Cloudflare. NOTE: the connected account is created but the owner must finish Stripe onboarding (verify owners/address/phone, bank, ID, accept terms) before it is 'charges enabled' — until then live card payments are declined by Stripe even though the id is set here.

hours._comment: 24-hour format. Source: owner-supplied. Sat 11:30-20:50; Sun & Mon 15:00-20:50; Tue-Fri 11:30-20:50. (8:50pm close = 20:50.)

_comment_closures: One-off emergency closures. Each "YYYY-MM-DD" (shop-local) takes online ordering OFFLINE for that whole day and shows a popup. Self-expires once the date passes. Empty means no closure in effect.
_comment_payments: Cash on collection AND delivery are ON so the shop can take online orders now (cash doesn't need Stripe). Card also works once the venue's Stripe Connect onboarding is charges-enabled. To make delivery prepaid-card-only, set cashOnDeliveryEnabled:false.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact us before ordering.
